summary: Post-market: a rotation day, not a risk-off day. 10 of 22 sectors/themes rose — fintech +1.1968, quantum computing +0.9426, internet platforms +0.8783 — while memory -1.4008 and semiconductor equipment -1.3993 led declines; AMD +2.1941 (1-week +15.2277) against NVDA -0.8416 and AVGO -1.5. The composite score rose 0.51 to 44.68 (weekly trend -1.79), regime goldilocks. Macro at 68.48 still binds: the 10-year real rate 2.63 sits at the 99.84 percentile and the FedWatch-implied 4.2 versus the 3.88 EFFR keeps a hike priced; CNBC flags surging Treasury yields as a new problem for the Fed, a move the layer's 2026-09-22 rate vintage has not yet captured. VIX fell 14.87 to 14.21, RRP firmed to 0.63 from 0.461, and the CN memory chain sold off in tandem (603986.SH -3.7495, 688825.SH -4.1283, 301308.SZ -4.1127).

top_risk_drivers.claim: The discount-rate constraint is still the dominant block: the 10-year real rate at 2.63 sits at the 99.84 percentile and the 10-year nominal at 4.96 at the 99.6 percentile, keeping macro at 68.48 — the highest of the six dimensions.

Policy pricing stays hard: the FedWatch-implied rate is 4.2 versus the 3.88 EFFR — a hike is the priced action — while the Philadelphia Fed's Paulson points to only modest moves ahead and CNBC frames surging yields as a brand new problem for the Fed.

The layer's rate block is a 2026-09-22 vintage — the 10-year shown unchanged at 4.96 with the 2-year easing from 4.76 to 4.71 — so the score's calm on rates partly reflects a stale daily series rather than the intraday surge the press describes.

Leadership rotated inside the AI complex: memory -1.4008 and semiconductor equipment -1.3993 led declines while fintech +1.1968, quantum computing +0.9426 and data centers +0.5453 rose — 10 of 22 sectors/themes up.
Breadth is still structurally weak: new highs at 0.0387 trail new lows at 0.071, the semis relative-strength line sits at -14.1171 and small caps at -10.3627.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility is the calmest block: VIX fell from 14.87 to 14.21 with realized vol at 10.8723, leaving the volatility dimension at 14.59.
Liquidity plumbing improved at the margin: RRP firmed to 0.63 from 0.461 (the CLS wire matches the layer) and reserve balances rose to 3013794 from 2991310.
Crypto is quiet: BTC holds 84581 (+0.16169) with ETH +0.81131 and SOL +2.68036 — no cross-asset stress signal.
The CN memory chain confirms the hardware drawdown: 603986.SH -3.7495, 688825.SH -4.1283, 301308.SZ -4.1127, all three in line with the US memory theme at -1.4008.
Credit stays near cycle lows: HY OAS 2.73 (from 2.68) and IG OAS 0.77 — no spread stress behind the equity rotation.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility is not confirming the rates stress: VIX at 14.21 sits near lows while CNBC headlines surging yields as the Fed's new problem — the two cannot both be the session's truth for long.
Breadth sends mixed messages: 0.6 of names above the 200-day looks healthy, yet new lows at 0.071 outnumber new highs at 0.0387.
Leadership inside semis is split: AMD +2.1941 (1-week +15.2277) against AVGO -1.5 and NVDA -0.8416 — no single AI trade.
Cross-asset confirmation is neutral at 0.5 — the tape's rotation has not registered as a directional risk signal.

Energy headlines run opposite to the risk score: oil futures settled sharply higher and Yemen's Houthis claim a strike on a Saudi Aramco facility at Yanbu, yet VIX still fell to 14.21 — the energy premium is not in the layer's numbers.

what_changed_today: Composite score +0.51 to 44.68, with the weekly trend at -1.79.
2-year yield 4.76 → 4.71 and the 10-year real rate 2.62 → 2.63, on the 2026-09-22 vintage; the 10-year nominal held 4.96.
Sector mix flipped to a rotation: 12 of 22 down — memory -1.4008, semiconductor equipment -1.3993, EV supply chain -1.3848 — against fintech +1.1968 and quantum computing +0.9426 up.
watch_next: FOMC on 2026-09-28 (18:00 UTC, high importance) — the hike is priced (implied 4.2 versus EFFR 3.88), so the statement and presser carry the risk.
Whether the next FRED vintage confirms the press's surging-yields narrative against the layer's 2026-09-22 rates.
Energy follow-through: the Yanbu strike claim and sharply higher oil settlements versus the normalizing Hormuz traffic (about 60 ships).
Whether the CN memory chain (603986.SH -3.7495) stabilizes or the drawdown broadens.
GDP and PCE on 2026-09-30, then the Employment Situation on 2026-10-02 — the inflation-labor mix that sets the hike path.

bull_case.title: Rotation, not distribution
points: VIX at 14.21 with realized vol 10.8723 — volatility near cycle lows while leadership rotates, the shape of a healthy tape.
Credit and liquidity are quiet: HY OAS 2.73, IG 0.77, RRP firmed to 0.63 and reserves rebuilt to 3013794.
10 of 22 sectors/themes rose with fintech +1.1968 and quantum computing +0.9426 — breadth of rotation, not capitulation.

base_case.title: Caution drift into the FOMC
points: The composite holds near 44.68 with macro at 68.48 capping risk appetite into 2026-09-28.
The hike stays priced at 4.2 implied versus 3.88 EFFR; Paulson's modest-moves framing keeps policy noise two-sided.
Memory and equipment stay heavy until the rates picture settles.

bear_case.title: Yields break, the tape follows
points: If the surging-yields narrative is confirmed by the next vintage — the 10-year through 4.96 and rising — the discount-rate shock of the prior session repeats.
Structure is already fragile: new lows 0.071 over new highs 0.0387, semis relative -14.1171, small caps -10.3627.
The CN memory chain at -3.7495 plus an energy premium (Houthi strike claim, oil settling sharply higher) tilts toward stagflation.
